name: second-brain
description: 🧠 AI Second Brain — 100% Local Knowledge Management Private, self-hosted second brain. Store, search, and synthesize documents, images, and ideas with local LLMs (LLaVA, CLIP) and PostgreSQL + pgvector. Features multimodal search, knowledge graphs, gDrive streaming, and real-time analysis — all offline, no API keys, no cloud, no limits.
